title: Tie-riffic Fake Cash
tagline: For the guy who still owes you money from that one game night, this tie made of Monopoly money is a subtle reminder to pay up, or a desperate attempt to blend in with the wealthy elite at your next family reunion.

title: Dwarf Core Knit Cap
tagline: For when your Dungeons & Dragons campaign takes a turn into *actual* dungeons. This knitted helmet is the perfect blend of 'I take my roleplay seriously' and 'I forgot to do laundry.' Ideal for LARPers who want to look like they walked out of a tapestry—or just really committed to their 'Mountain Man' phase.

title: Superhero Rollercoaster Mayhem
tagline: When your toddler’s obsession with Batman meets their newfound love for death-defying stunts, this steel coaster set is the perfect compromise. Watch as they navigate the perilous twists and turns of Gotham’s skyline, all while safely contained within the confines of your living room. Just don’t blame us if they start demanding a real Batmobile next.

title: Pizza Dreams, Cheese Reality
tagline: For the night owl who's torn between late-night snacking and sleeping like a normal person. This bedspread lets you indulge in a cheese pizza fantasy without the heartburn. Perfect for those who've ever woken up craving a slice at 3 AM—now you can at least pretend you're eating one. Just don't try to fold it like a real pizza; the cheese won't stretch.

title: AT-ATs: The Family Minivan
tagline: Because nothing says 'road trip' like a herd of Imperial walkers lumbering across your Honda. Perfect for the parent who wants their kids to feel like they're being marched to Endor. Includes 5 stickers, so you can finally have that AT-AT convoy you've always dreamed of.

title: R2-D2’s Thirst Quencher
tagline: Because nothing says 'I’m a Jedi master of hydration' like sipping a lukewarm beer from a droid-shaped can cooler. Perfect for when you’re tailgating in the Mos Eisley Cantina parking lot and need to keep your Blue Milk cold. Just don’t let Jabba catch you using it.

title: Clackity Wooden Keyboard Throne
tagline: For the mechanical keyboard enthusiast who’s tired of their desk looking like a tech graveyard. This wooden rack elevates your clacking to a whole new level—literally. Perfect for the remote worker who needs to convince their cat that the keyboard is not a scratching post, or the streamer who wants their setup to look like a 19th-century telegraph office. Just don’t blame us if your coworkers start asking if you’re typing or performing a séance.

title: Drink the Rainbow, Skip the Leprechaun
tagline: For the person who insists their margarita should match their mood ring. These coupe glasses turn every sip into a tiny liquid rainbow—ideal for the backyard BBQ where someone inevitably asks, 'Is that a drink or a science experiment?' Perfect for the cocktail connoisseur who also owns a lava lamp.

title: Spy on Fish, Affordably!
tagline: Tired of guessing what Gertrude the goldfish is *really* up to? Forgo that therapist bill and dive into her world. This underwater drone lets you explore sunken grocery carts in your local pond or maybe just check your boat hull. Finally, solid proof that Gertrude *is* judging you.

title: Jeans Couch: Sit on Your Style
tagline: For the person who insists their living room is a '90s nightclub, this denim sofa is the perfect blend of nostalgia and questionable life choices. Ideal for the bachelor who wants to impress their date by saying, 'Yeah, I sleep on a couch made of my old Levi's.' Just don't ask about the mysterious stains.

title: Bike Brain for Overthinkers
tagline: For the cyclist who needs to quantify their existential dread. This gadget tracks your speed, cadence, and probably your soul’s alignment with the universe. Perfect for when you’re pedaling through a mid-life crisis at 15 mph and need data to justify your lycra obsession.

title: Unicorn Poop in a Tin
tagline: For when your office potluck needs a splash of 'what were they thinking?' This isn't just dessert—it's a conversation starter for people who've run out of things to say. Perfect for that coworker who insists on bringing their 'homemade' treats but actually just buys them from a gas station.

title: Moths’ Last Stand
tagline: For when your midnight snack cravings are outshone by your need to summon a tiny, glittery rebellion. Light this candle in your dorm room, and suddenly, your RA’s ‘quiet hours’ email is the least of your worries. Bonus: the wax smells like the regret of a forgotten childhood promise.

title: Galactic Decor Gone Wrong
tagline: Because your living room was missing a dash of Imperial despair, these Death Star tiles bring balance to your decorating chaos, perfect for when in-laws come over and you want to subtly hint at your feelings.

title: Beast Mode: Paper Edition
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm a responsible adult' like showing up to a corporate retreat as a paper tiger. Perfect for that one coworker who insists on 'team-building exercises' involving trust falls. Includes templates for lion, fox, and a very confused-looking platypus. Assembly required—no scissors, no excuses.

title: Batter Up, Bake Off
tagline: For the baker who’s tired of choosing between blondies and brownies—why not both? These are the perfect snack for your coworker who insists on bringing cake batter-flavored everything to the office. Now you can enjoy the raw batter taste without the salmonella scare. Just don’t blame us if your coworkers start asking for a side of frosting.

title: Faux Fur for Your Faux Friend
tagline: Your dog’s winter wardrobe just got an upgrade—because nothing says 'I care' like dressing your pup in what looks like a discarded muppet. Perfect for those chilly park dates where your pooch needs to blend in with the hipster crowd. Bonus: It’s machine washable, so when your dog inevitably rolls in something questionable, you can pretend it was just a fashion statement.

title: The Lock That Judges Your Pajamas
tagline: Because nothing says 'I trust you' like a lock that only opens if you're wearing matching socks. Perfect for the roommate who insists on 'casual Fridays' in their underwear, or the Airbnb guest who thinks 'business casual' means a bathrobe. Biometric? More like bi-curious about your life choices.

title: Bowl of Cosmic Chaos
tagline: For the dinner party where you want to serve salad and existential dread, this Yin Yang bowl is perfect. It's like a metaphor for your relationship, but edible.

title: The Library of Babel, But Make It Home Decor
tagline: For the person who wants their books to look like they’re being sucked into a black hole. Perfect for the minimalist who insists their collection of first editions needs to defy gravity. Just don’t ask how you’re supposed to find that one book you swore you had.

title: Gears for Your Ears
tagline: For when your time-traveling adventures require a subtle nod to Victorian engineering. These earrings whisper 'I could fix a steam engine' while you're stuck in a TSA line. Perfect for the Renaissance fair enthusiast who also enjoys confusing airport security.

title: Beach Bot in a Box
tagline: For the friend who's always building sandcastles, but secretly wants to engineer a mechanical beast to roam the shores. This mini Strandbeest kit is their weird, wonderful dream come true.

title: Shower in Disco Hell
tagline: For when you want to blind yourself with color while washing away last night's poor life choices, this rainbow LED shower head is oddly perfect.

title: Naptime for Grownups
tagline: Because sometimes you need to escape the existential dread of adulthood, but your couch has seen better days. This inflatable paradise is perfect for that afternoon when you realize you’ve been staring at the same spreadsheet for three hours and your soul is slowly evaporating. Just add a piña colada and pretend you’re not avoiding your inbox.

title: Dinnerware for the Clumsy Mermaid
tagline: For those who’ve ever dreamed of dining like a sea creature, these floating utensils are your ticket. Perfect for the poolside picnic where your hands are full of sunscreen and your plate is doing laps. Or maybe you’re just tired of fishing your fork out of the soup. Either way, these are the tools for the job.

title: Fancy Feathers for Your Forgotten Flowers
tagline: Because nothing says 'I forgot your anniversary' like a vase that looks like a peacock trying to impress a wilting bouquet. Perfect for that friend who insists their apartment is a 'bohemian paradise' but still has a toaster from 2005. Bonus: Confuse your guests into thinking you have an actual peacock in the next room.

title: Lakitu's Judgy Cloud
tagline: For when you need a lamp that silently judges you, like Lakitu from Mario Bros. This cloud-shaped lamp is perfect for a gamer's melancholy night, lit only by the soft glow of their failed jump attempts.

title: Dad Jokes: The Nuclear Option
tagline: For when you need to clear a room faster than a fire alarm. Perfect for that awkward family dinner where your cousin’s new partner just won’t stop talking about their ‘spiritual journey.’ One joke and suddenly everyone’s ‘remembering’ they left the stove on. Comes with a warning label: ‘Not responsible for eye rolls or sudden exits.’

title: Burger of Comfort
tagline: For the meat lover who refuses to let their passion for burgers end at the dinner table. Perfect for those nights when you're craving a late-night snack but your stomach says 'no'—just hug this pillow instead. Warning: may cause drooling on your couch.

title: Puffin’s Last Stand
tagline: For when your beer can is too hot to handle, but your hands are too cold to care. This insulated puffin hugs your beverage like a Viking warrior protecting their mead. Perfect for that one friend who insists on drinking a warm IPA while watching *The Great British Bake Off* in a snowstorm.
